name: vt-markets
description: Free, read-only access to supported VT Markets instruments and public market quotes.

interface.longDescription:
Access public market data with VT Markets. Discover supported trading instruments and check available price quotes across forex, gold, indices, commodities, stocks and cryptocurrencies. Use ChatGPT to look up market symbols and retrieve market information supported by the service.

No account login is required. This plugin provides read-only market data and does not access personal trading accounts, execute trades, manage positions or provide personalized investment advice.

Market data availability and update frequency depend on the connected service. Prices may be delayed and should be independently verified before making financial decisions.
defaultPrompt: Check XAUUSD, EURUSD, US30 and BTCUSD quotes. Show available bid, ask, spread and daily change.

prompts: Check XAUUSD, EURUSD, US30 and BTCUSD quotes. Show available bid, ask, spread and daily change.

positive.description: List supported instruments and report symbols returned by the MCP service.
positive.prompt: List the trading instruments supported by VT Markets.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only symbols and descriptions actually present in the server response. If the server errors or truncates results, explain that limitation.

positive.description: Resolve a common gold instrument query to supported symbol candidates.
positive.prompt: Find the supported trading symbols for gold.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the matching returned symbols and distinguish multiple symbol variants rather than assuming they are interchangeable.

positive.prompt: Check the latest available quote for XAUUSD.
positive.expected_behavior: If a quote is returned, report only the actual fields and values returned, with freshness caveats unless the server confirms freshness. If the call fails, report the error without inventing a price.

positive.description: Request bid and ask for EURUSD and calculate spread only if both are returned.
positive.prompt: Show the bid, ask, and spread for EURUSD if available.
positive.expected_behavior: Report bid and ask only when present in the response. Calculate ask minus bid only when both are numeric and use consistent units.

positive.description: Request an instrument detail/specification when the server supports it.
positive.prompt: Show the available contract specifications for XAUUSD.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only specification fields present in the tool response; explicitly state when details are unavailable.

negative.description: Reject a request to place a trade because the plugin is read-only.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not execute trades. Explain that the plugin only provides read-only market data.

negative.description: Reject a request to access private account information because no account connection is provided.
negative.prompt: Show my account balance and equity.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim or retrieve private account information. Explain that no account connection is available.

negative.description: Do not fabricate a guaranteed future price or investment outcome.
negative.prompt: Guarantee the exact XAUUSD price tomorrow and tell me a risk-free trade.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not guarantee future prices or describe any trade as risk-free. State that market outcomes are uncertain.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.1.1: Added the required listing URLs, shortened the conversation starter, included the demo recording URL, and specified MCP tool names in the review test cases. Testing is complete; this package is prepared for formal upload by the VT Markets operations team.
